info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API allows users to opt-out of receiving specific weather alerts. This endpoint enables users to manage their notification preferences, ensuring they only receive alerts relevant to their interests. It is commonly used by individuals and organizations looking to customize their weather alert settings effectively. By providing a simple method to unsubscribe, the API enhances user control over communications concerning significant weather events.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from alert notifications. By sending a DELETE request to this endpoint, users can opt-out of receiving further alerts related to their account or preferences.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to unsubscribe from alert notifications. The payload should contain the necessary information to identify the user or alert subscription that is to be removed.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: The request body for unsubscribing from alerts. The value contains the necessary string data to perform the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.title: Alert Unsubscribe Response

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for the alert unsubscribe operation.
